## gh-1439 rework — all three blockers and all three suggestions addressed (commits on the head)

The fixes landed in the `19:13–19:48` commit round on `ai/gh-1439` (head now past `edb160e2`), plus a cleanup commit dropping the scratch probe the WIP auto-save had left behind. Every fix was RED-first: the new test failed against the pre-fix code before the change.

### 🚨 1. E1 held-anchor drift on trims — fixed (row-exact)

`_heldAnchorShiftedByCut` (`lib/src/cli/fa_tui_viewport.dart:163`) no longer indexes the PRE-trim wrap cache at the shifted line (`starts[heldAnchorLine - cut]`). A same-width trim only removes head rows from the unchanged wrapped layout, so the fix shifts the **raw offset** by the rows the dropped head consumed:

```dart
final droppedRows = starts[cut.clamp(0, starts.length - 1)];
final newBottom = (bottom - droppedRows).clamp(0, bottom);
return (shifted, (scrollOffset - droppedRows).clamp(0, newBottom));
```

Two notes against the prescribed `starts[heldAnchorLine] - starts[cut]` formula:

- That formula alone still snaps a mid-line window up to the anchor line's start row (up to the line's wrap height) — the new regression test caught that intermediate version drifting 1 row.
- The fence-repair synthetic (`cut` is raw-cut − 1 there) can still drift the row by one dropped line's height in that rare shape (noted in code).

**RED first**: `test/cli/fa_tui_follow_mode_test.dart` now has a trim-while-held test with **variable-height lines** (200-char lines every 7th entry) that crosses the 2400-line cap **after** the hold (`cut > 0` exercised — the old E1 test's trim fired before the hold and passed vacuously). It failed on the old math (window drifted several rows) and pins byte-identical rendered rows now.

### 🚨 2. `⌄ N new` counter inflation on history-page loads — fixed (content-aware tail-growth check + the flush it was hiding)

Two defects fixed in `packages/fa_ui/lib/src/chat/fa_chat_screen.dart`:

1. **Counting** (the `fa_chat_screen.dart:998` finding): the arrival check is now **content-aware**. Ids are index-based (`msg-$index`), so a "Load earlier" prepend shifts every row's content while **reusing every id** — the id-based `commonPrefix` stayed `== oldLen` and `newLen - commonPrefix` billed the loaded page as arrivals. The count now scans a content-aware prefix (`countedPrefix`, via the existing `_messageChanged`); arrivals exist iff `countedPrefix == oldLen && newLen > oldLen`, count = `newLen - oldLen` — exactly the prescribed shape, hardened against the id-reuse hole. The render diff keeps the id-based prefix (in-place edits must `updateMessage`, not remove+insert).
2. **The flush behind the repro**: while testing the prepend scenario the pill vanished entirely. Traced: the big-diff `setMessages` re-anchor glides the position for several frames and settles **inside the arm band**; the non-drag relatch then flushed counted arrivals as a fake "user landed back". The non-drag relatch is now gated on a **user gesture in flight** (`_userGestureInFlight`: set by drag updates, kept through `ScrollEnd(dragDetails != null)`, invalidated by content syncs) — content-driven settles can neither flush the count nor hold.

**RED first**: two widget tests — hold → prepend 25 → pill stays at its previous count, and a zero-arrivals prepend never shows the pill. Both failed on the old code (pill showed «25/28 new», or vanished).

### 🚨 3. Wheel/trackpad disengage — implemented (raw PointerScrollEvent classification)

The transcript is now wrapped in a raw `Listener(onPointerSignal: ...)` (`fa_chat_screen.dart:1428`) that marks `PointerScrollEvent` ticks (`_wheelGesturePending`); the next depth-0 scroll update they produce classifies through the **same** `FollowMode.userScrolled` machine as a drag — wheel-up beyond the arm band holds and counts arrivals, wheel-down into the band re-arms live (the reversed-list sign translation is Flutter's own `axisDirectionIsReversed` handling).

E6 stays true, in both directions:

- Programmatic moves can never hold — only the pending-flag path enters the classify branch, and it is consumed by the first classified update.
- Programmatic moves can no longer relatch either (traced while fixing the counter thread): the non-drag relatch is gated on `_userGestureInFlight` (drag/coast only, invalidated by content syncs). Before this gate, a big-diff `setMessages` re-anchor settled at ~60px ≤ arm 80 and the classifier flushed the held count as a fake "user landed back".

**RED first**: two widget tests drive `tester.sendEventToBinding(PointerScrollEvent(...))` — wheel-up during a run arms the pill (failed on the old code: `dragDetails == null` never classified, pill never armed) and wheel-down back to the near-bottom re-arms live.

### 💡 Suggestions — applied

- **One width measure** (`lib/src/cli/fa_tui_rows.dart:213`): `progressWidth = tuiTextWidth('$progressText$counterText')` — the emitted styled run is measured as one string.
- **One owner for the re-engage**: the "Load newer" banner tap is the `_jumpToLive` tear-off (relatch + E4 deep-page-then-jump ordering included; unawaited at the call site). The hand-rolled copy is gone.
- **`heldPreservingUnseen()`** is now library-private `_heldPreservingUnseen()` (only caller: `userScrolled()`); the counting-unit doc on `appended()` states the unit is surface-defined (TUI counts `OutputMsg` events, the app counts message rows) so `● N new` and `⌄ N new` are never "unified" by accident (`lib/src/viewport/follow_mode.dart:96`).

### Verification

- `dart test test/viewport/follow_mode_test.dart test/cli/fa_tui_follow_mode_test.dart` — **38/38** (incl. the new variable-height trim test).
- `cd packages/fa_ui && flutter test` — **581/581** (pill suite 11/11 incl. the two prepend and two wheel regressions; `#1159` banner suite green).
- PTY IT (`test/integration/fa_tui_follow_pty_test.dart --tags integration`) and the full core suite re-run on this head — results in the top-level rework summary.

# GOAL — flutter_agent_harness

## Objective

Build the **ideal cross-platform AI agent harness in Dart**, ported from the
architecture of **pi-mono** (`packages/ai` + `packages/agent`), publishable on
pub.dev and runnable everywhere Dart runs: **VM, Flutter desktop, iOS/Android,
and web**. The core package must stay **pure Dart** — no `dart:io`, no Flutter
imports in `lib/` (platform specifics live behind abstractions).

This repo is the successor to the adk_dart-based assistant stack in the
`yoclip` project; once mature it will power the yoclip Studio AI assistant.

## Reference codebases (read these first)

### Primary architecture reference — pi-mono

`/Users/Uladzimir_Klyshevich/git/references/pi/`

- `packages/ai/` (~8.7k LOC TS) — provider adapters behind one contract:
  `stream(model, context, options) → AssistantMessageEventStream`.
  Study these files before writing any provider code:

    canonical adapter; also covers OpenRouter (`baseUrl` swap, first-class).

    hand-rolled SSE decoder at lines 260–409; port this to Dart.
  - `packages/ai/src/stream.ts` — event contract:
    `start → text/thinking/toolcall_{start,delta,end} → done|error`, every
    delta event carries the **live partial message** (partial-first design).
  - `packages/ai/src/utils/overflow.ts` — provider-specific context-overflow
    detection via error-message regexes.
  - **Invariant to preserve: providers never throw.** All failures —
    network, 429, abort, malformed SSE — arrive as an `error` event with
    `stopReason: error|aborted`. The agent loop never sees an exception from
    a provider.
- `packages/agent/` (~8.1k LOC TS):
  - `packages/agent/src/agent-loop.ts` (748 LOC) — the low-level async loop;
    port its shape, not its incidental JS-isms.

The fixes landed in the `19:13–19:48` commit round on `ai/gh-1439` (head now past `edb160e2`), plus a cleanup commit dropping the scratch probe the WIP auto-save had left behind. Every fix was RED-first: the new test failed against the pre-fix code before the change.

### 🚨 1. E1 held-anchor drift on trims — fixed (row-exact)

`_heldAnchorShiftedByCut` (`lib/src/cli/fa_tui_viewport.dart:163`) no longer indexes the PRE-trim wrap cache at the shifted line (`starts[heldAnchorLine - cut]`). A same-width trim only removes head rows from the unchanged wrapped layout, so the fix shifts the **raw offset** by the rows the dropped head consumed:

```dart
final droppedRows = starts[cut.clamp(0, starts.length - 1)];
final newBottom = (bottom - droppedRows).clamp(0, bottom);
return (shifted, (scrollOffset - droppedRows).clamp(0, newBottom));
```

Two notes against the prescribed `starts[heldAnchorLine] - starts[cut]` formula:

- That formula alone still snaps a mid-line window up to the anchor line's start row (up to the line's wrap height) — the new regression test caught that intermediate version drifting 1 row.
- The fence-repair synthetic (`cut` is raw-cut − 1 there) can still drift the row by one dropped line's height in that rare shape (noted in code).

**RED first**: `test/cli/fa_tui_follow_mode_test.dart` now has a trim-while-held test with **variable-height lines** (200-char lines every 7th entry) that crosses the 2400-line cap **after** the hold (`cut > 0` exercised — the old E1 test's trim fired before the hold and passed vacuously). It failed on the old math (window drifted several rows) and pins byte-identical rendered rows now.

### 🚨 2. `⌄ N new` counter inflation on history-page loads — fixed (content-aware tail-growth check + the flush it was hiding)

Two defects fixed in `packages/fa_ui/lib/src/chat/fa_chat_screen.dart`:

1. **Counting** (the `fa_chat_screen.dart:998` finding): the arrival check is now **content-aware**. Ids are index-based (`msg-$index`), so a "Load earlier" prepend shifts every row's content while **reusing every id** — the id-based `commonPrefix` stayed `== oldLen` and `newLen - commonPrefix` billed the loaded page as arrivals. The count now scans a content-aware prefix (`countedPrefix`, via the existing `_messageChanged`); arrivals exist iff `countedPrefix == oldLen && newLen > oldLen`, count = `newLen - oldLen` — exactly the prescribed shape, hardened against the id-reuse hole. The render diff keeps the id-based prefix (in-place edits must `updateMessage`, not remove+insert).
2. **The flush behind the repro**: while testing the prepend scenario the pill vanished entirely. Traced: the big-diff `setMessages` re-anchor glides the position for several frames and settles **inside the arm band**; the non-drag relatch then flushed counted arrivals as a fake "user landed back". The non-drag relatch is now gated on a **user gesture in flight** (`_userGestureInFlight`: set by drag updates, kept through `ScrollEnd(dragDetails != null)`, invalidated by content syncs) — content-driven settles can neither flush the count nor hold.

**RED first**: two widget tests — hold → prepend 25 → pill stays at its previous count, and a zero-arrivals prepend never shows the pill. Both failed on the old code (pill showed «25/28 new», or vanished).

### 🚨 3. Wheel/trackpad disengage — implemented (raw PointerScrollEvent classification)

The transcript is now wrapped in a raw `Listener(onPointerSignal: ...)` (`fa_chat_screen.dart:1428`) that marks `PointerScrollEvent` ticks (`_wheelGesturePending`); the next depth-0 scroll update they produce classifies through the **same** `FollowMode.userScrolled` machine as a drag — wheel-up beyond the arm band holds and counts arrivals, wheel-down into the band re-arms live (the reversed-list sign translation is Flutter's own `axisDirectionIsReversed` handling).

E6 stays true, in both directions:

- Programmatic moves can never hold — only the pending-flag path enters the classify branch, and it is consumed by the first classified update.
- Programmatic moves can no longer relatch either (traced while fixing the counter thread): the non-drag relatch is gated on `_userGestureInFlight` (drag/coast only, invalidated by content syncs). Before this gate, a big-diff `setMessages` re-anchor settled at ~60px ≤ arm 80 and the classifier flushed the held count as a fake "user landed back".

**RED first**: two widget tests drive `tester.sendEventToBinding(PointerScrollEvent(...))` — wheel-up during a run arms the pill (failed on the old code: `dragDetails == null` never classified, pill never armed) and wheel-down back to the near-bottom re-arms live.

### 💡 Suggestions — applied

- **One width measure** (`lib/src/cli/fa_tui_rows.dart:213`): `progressWidth = tuiTextWidth('$progressText$counterText')` — the emitted styled run is measured as one string.

# GOAL — flutter_agent_harness

## Objective

Build the **ideal cross-platform AI agent harness in Dart**, ported from the
architecture of **pi-mono** (`packages/ai` + `packages/agent`), publishable on
pub.dev and runnable everywhere Dart runs: **VM, Flutter desktop, iOS/Android,
and web**. The core package must stay **pure Dart** — no `dart:io`, no Flutter
imports in `lib/` (platform specifics live behind abstractions).

This repo is the successor to the adk_dart-based assistant stack in the
`yoclip` project; once mature it will power the yoclip Studio AI assistant.

## Reference codebases (read these first)

### Primary architecture reference — pi-mono

    detection via error-message regexes.

The fixes landed in the `19:13–19:48` commit round on `ai/gh-1439` (head now past `edb160e2`), plus a cleanup commit dropping the scratch probe the WIP auto-save had left behind. Every fix was RED-first: the new test failed against the pre-fix code before the change.

### 🚨 1. E1 held-anchor drift on trims — fixed (row-exact)

`_heldAnchorShiftedByCut` (`lib/src/cli/fa_tui_viewport.dart:163`) no longer indexes the PRE-trim wrap cache at the shifted line (`starts[heldAnchorLine - cut]`). A same-width trim only removes head rows from the unchanged wrapped layout, so the fix shifts the **raw offset** by the rows the dropped head consumed:

```dart
final droppedRows = starts[cut.clamp(0, starts.length - 1)];
final newBottom = (bottom - droppedRows).clamp(0, bottom);
return (shifted, (scrollOffset - droppedRows).clamp(0, newBottom));
```

Two notes against the prescribed `starts[heldAnchorLine] - starts[cut]` formula:

- That formula alone still snaps a mid-line window up to the anchor line's start row (up to the line's wrap height) — the new regression test caught that intermediate version drifting 1 row.
- The fence-repair synthetic (`cut` is raw-cut − 1 there) can still drift the row by one dropped line's height in that rare shape (noted in code).

**RED first**: `test/cli/fa_tui_follow_mode_test.dart` now has a trim-while-held test with **variable-height lines** (200-char lines every 7th entry) that crosses the 2400-line cap **after** the hold (`cut > 0` exercised — the old E1 test's trim fired before the hold and passed vacuously). It failed on the old math (window drifted several rows) and pins byte-identical rendered rows now.

### 🚨 2. `⌄ N new` counter inflation on history-page loads — fixed (content-aware tail-growth check + the flush it was hiding)

Two defects fixed in `packages/fa_ui/lib/src/chat/fa_chat_screen.dart`:

1. **Counting** (the `fa_chat_screen.dart:998` finding): the arrival check is now **content-aware**. Ids are index-based (`msg-$index`), so a "Load earlier" prepend shifts every row's content while **reusing every id** — the id-based `commonPrefix` stayed `== oldLen` and `newLen - commonPrefix` billed the loaded page as arrivals. The count now scans a content-aware prefix (`countedPrefix`, via the existing `_messageChanged`); arrivals exist iff `countedPrefix == oldLen && newLen > oldLen`, count = `newLen - oldLen` — exactly the prescribed shape, hardened against the id-reuse hole. The render diff keeps the id-based prefix (in-place edits must `updateMessage`, not remove+insert).
2. **The flush behind the repro**: while testing the prepend scenario the pill vanished entirely. Traced: the big-diff `setMessages` re-anchor glides the position for several frames and settles **inside the arm band**; the non-drag relatch then flushed counted arrivals as a fake "user landed back". The non-drag relatch is now gated on a **user gesture in flight** (`_userGestureInFlight`: set by drag updates, kept through `ScrollEnd(dragDetails != null)`, invalidated by content syncs) — content-driven settles can neither flush the count nor hold.

**RED first**: two widget tests — hold → prepend 25 → pill stays at its previous count, and a zero-arrivals prepend never shows the pill. Both failed on the old code (pill showed «25/28 new», or vanished).

### 🚨 3. Wheel/trackpad disengage — implemented (raw PointerScrollEvent classification)

The transcript is now wrapped in a raw `Listener(onPointerSignal: ...)` (`fa_chat_screen.dart:1428`) that marks `PointerScrollEvent` ticks (`_wheelGesturePending`); the next depth-0 scroll update they produce classifies through the **same** `FollowMode.userScrolled` machine as a drag — wheel-up beyond the arm band holds and counts arrivals, wheel-down into the band re-arms live (the reversed-list sign translation is Flutter's own `axisDirectionIsReversed` handling).

E6 stays true, in both directions:

- Programmatic moves can never hold — only the pending-flag path enters the classify branch, and it is consumed by the first classified update.
- Programmatic moves can no longer relatch either (traced while fixing the counter thread): the non-drag relatch is gated on `_userGestureInFlight` (drag/coast only, invalidated by content syncs). Before this gate, a big-diff `setMessages` re-anchor settled at ~60px ≤ arm 80 and the classifier flushed the held count as a fake "user landed back".

**RED first**: two widget tests drive `tester.sendEventToBinding(PointerScrollEvent(...))` — wheel-up during a run arms the pill (failed on the old code: `dragDetails == null` never classified, pill never armed) and wheel-down back to the near-bottom re-arms live.

### 💡 Suggestions — applied

- **One width measure** (`lib/src/cli/fa_tui_rows.dart:213`): `progressWidth = tuiTextWidth('$progressText$counterText')` — the emitted styled run is measured as one string.
- **One owner for the re-engage**: the "Load newer" banner tap is the `_jumpToLive` tear-off (relatch + E4 deep-page-then-jump ordering included; unawaited at the call site). The hand-rolled copy is gone.
- **`heldPreservingUnseen()`** is now library-private `_heldPreservingUnseen()` (only caller: `userScrolled()`); the counting-unit doc on `appended()` states the unit is surface-defined (TUI counts `OutputMsg` events, the app counts message rows) so `● N new` and `⌄ N new` are never "unified" by accident (`lib/src/viewport/follow_mode.dart:96`).

- `dart test test/viewport/follow_mode_test.dart test/cli/fa_tui_follow_mode_test.dart` — **38/38** (incl. the new variable-height trim test).
- `cd packages/fa_ui && flutter test` — **581/581** (pill suite 11/11 incl. the two prepend and two wheel regressions; `#1159` banner suite green).
- PTY IT (`test/integration/fa_tui_follow_pty_test.dart --tags integration`) and the full core suite re-run on this head — results in the top-level rework summary.

# GOAL — flutter_agent_harness

## Objective

Build the **ideal cross-platform AI agent harness in Dart**, ported from the
architecture of **pi-mono** (`packages/ai` + `packages/agent`), publishable on
pub.dev and runnable everywhere Dart runs: **VM, Flutter desktop, iOS/Android,
and web**. The core package must stay **pure Dart** — no `dart:io`, no Flutter
imports in `lib/` (platform specifics live behind abstractions).

This repo is the successor to the adk_dart-based assistant stack in the
`yoclip` project; once mature it will power the yoclip Studio AI assistant.

## Reference codebases (read these first)

### Primary architecture reference — pi-mono

`/Users/Uladzimir_Klyshevich/git/references/pi/`

- `packages/ai/` (~8.7k LOC TS) — provider adapters behind one contract:
  `stream(model, context, options) → AssistantMessageEventStream`.
  Study these files before writing any provider code:
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/openai-completions.ts` (~1205 LOC) — the
    canonical adapter; also covers OpenRouter (`baseUrl` swap, first-class).
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/anthropic.ts` (~1242 LOC) — includes a
    hand-rolled SSE decoder at lines 260–409; port this to Dart.
  - `packages/ai/src/stream.ts` — event contract:
    `start → text/thinking/toolcall_{start,delta,end} → done|error`, every
    delta event carries the **live partial message** (partial-first design).
  - `packages/ai/src/utils/overflow.ts` — provider-specific context-overflow
    detection via error-message regexes.
  - **Invariant to preserve: providers never throw.** All failures —
    network, 429, abort, malformed SSE — arrive as an `error` event with
    `stopReason: error|aborted`. The agent loop never sees an exception from
    a provider.

{"path":"outputs/review_replies/thread_18.md","content":"## gh-1439 rework — all three blockers and all three suggestions addressed (commits on the head)

The fixes landed in the `19:13–19:48` commit round on `ai/gh-1439` (head now past `edb160e2`), plus a cleanup commit dropping the scratch probe the WIP auto-save had left behind. Every fix was RED-first: the new test failed against the pre-fix code before the change.

### 🚨 1. E1 held-anchor drift on trims — fixed (row-exact)

`_heldAnchorShiftedByCut` (`lib/src/cli/fa_tui_viewport.dart:163`) no longer indexes the PRE-trim wrap cache at the shifted line (`starts[heldAnchorLine - cut]`). A same-width trim only removes head rows from the unchanged wrapped layout, so the fix shifts the **raw offset** by the rows the dropped head consumed:

```dart
final droppedRows = starts[cut.clamp(0, starts.length - 1)];
final newBottom = (bottom - droppedRows).clamp(0, bottom);
return (shifted, (scrollOffset - droppedRows).clamp(0, newBottom));
```

Two notes against the prescribed `starts[heldAnchorLine] - starts[cut]` formula:

- That formula alone still snaps a mid-line window up to the anchor line's start row (up to the line's wrap height) — the new regression test caught that intermediate version drifting 1 row.
- The fence-repair synthetic (`cut` is raw-cut − 1 there) can still drift the row by one dropped line's height in that rare shape (noted in code).

**RED first**: `test/cli/fa_tui_follow_mode_test.dart` now has a trim-while-held test with **variable-height lines** (200-char lines every 7th entry) that crosses the 2400-line cap **after** the hold (`cut > 0` exercised — the old E1 test's trim fired before the hold and passed vacuously). It failed on the old math (window drifted several rows) and pins byte-identical rendered rows now.

### 🚨 2. `⌄ N new` counter inflation on history-page loads — fixed (content-aware tail-growth check + the flush it was hiding)

Two defects fixed in `packages/fa_ui/lib/src/chat/fa_chat_screen.dart`:

1. **Counting** (the `fa_chat_screen.dart:998` finding): the arrival check is now **content-aware**. Ids are index-based (`msg-$index`), so a "Load earlier" prepend shifts every row's content while **reusing every id** — the id-based `commonPrefix` stayed `== oldLen` and `newLen - commonPrefix` billed the loaded page as arrivals. The count now scans a content-aware prefix (`countedPrefix`, via the existing `_messageChanged`); arrivals exist iff `countedPrefix == oldLen && newLen > oldLen`, count = `newLen - oldLen` — exactly the prescribed shape, hardened against the id-reuse hole. The render diff keeps the id-based prefix (in-place edits must `updateMessage`, not remove+insert).
2. **The flush behind the repro**: while testing the prepend scenario the pill vanished entirely. Traced: the big-diff `setMessages` re-anchor glides the position for several frames and settles **inside the arm band**; the non-drag relatch then flushed counted arrivals as a fake "user landed back". The non-drag relatch is now gated on a **user gesture in flight** (`_userGestureInFlight`: set by drag updates, kept through `ScrollEnd(dragDetails != null)`, invalidated by content syncs) — content-driven settles can neither flush the count nor hold.

**RED first**: two widget tests — hold → prepend 25 → pill stays at its previous count, and a zero-arrivals prepend never shows the pill. Both failed on the old code (pill showed «25/28 new», or vanished).

### 🚨 3. Wheel/trackpad disengage — implemented (raw PointerScrollEvent classification)

The transcript is now wrapped in a raw `Listener(onPointerSignal: ...)` (`fa_chat_screen.dart:1428`) that marks `PointerScrollEvent` ticks (`_wheelGesturePending`); the next depth-0 scroll update they produce classifies through the **same** `FollowMode.userScrolled` machine as a drag — wheel-up beyond the arm band holds and counts arrivals, wheel-down into the band re-arms live (the reversed-list sign translation is Flutter's own `axisDirectionIsReversed` handling).

E6 stays true, in both directions:

- Programmatic moves can never hold — only the pending-flag path enters the classify branch, and it is consumed by the first classified update.
- Programmatic moves can no longer relatch either (traced while fixing the counter thread): the non-drag relatch is gated on `_userGestureInFlight` (drag/coast only, invalidated by content syncs). Before this gate, a big-diff `setMessages` re-anchor settled at ~60px ≤ arm 80 and the classifier flushed the held count as a fake "user landed back".

**RED first**: two widget tests drive `tester.sendEventToBinding(PointerScrollEvent(...))` — wheel-up during a run arms the pill (failed on the old code: `dragDetails == null` never classified, pill never armed) and wheel-down back to the near-bottom re-arms live.

### 💡 Suggestions — applied

- **One width measure** (`lib/src/cli/fa_tui_rows.dart:213`): `progressWidth = tuiTextWidth('$progressText$counterText')` — the emitted styled run is measured as one string.
- **One owner for the re-engage**: the "Load newer" banner tap is the `_jumpToLive` tear-off (relatch + E4 deep-page-then-jump ordering included; unawaited at the call site). The hand-rolled copy is gone.
- **`heldPreservingUnseen()`** is now library-private `_heldPreservingUnseen()` (only caller: `userScrolled()`); the counting-unit doc on `appended()` states the unit is surface-defined (TUI counts `OutputMsg` events, the app counts message rows) so `● N new` and `⌄ N new` are never "unified" by accident (`lib/src/viewport/follow_mode.dart:96`).

- PTY IT (`test/integration/fa_tui_follow_pty_test.dart --tags integration`) and the full core suite re-run on this head — results in the top-level rework summary.

# GOAL — flutter_agent_harness

## Objective

Build the **ideal cross-platform AI agent harness in Dart**, ported from the
architecture of **pi-mono** (`packages/ai` + `packages/agent`), publishable on
pub.dev and runnable everywhere Dart runs: **VM, Flutter desktop, iOS/Android,
and web**. The core package must stay **pure Dart** — no `dart:io`, no Flutter
imports in `lib/` (platform specifics live behind abstractions).

This repo is the successor to the adk_dart-based assistant stack in the
`yoclip` project; once mature it will power the yoclip Studio AI assistant.

## Reference codebases (read these first)

### Primary architecture reference — pi-mono

    detection via error-message regexes.

{"path":"outputs/review_replies/thread_18.md","content":"## gh-1439 rework — all three blockers and all three suggestions addressed (commits on the head)

The fixes landed in the `19:13–19:48` commit round on `ai/gh-1439` (head now past `edb160e2`), plus a cleanup commit dropping the scratch probe the WIP auto-save had left behind. Every fix was RED-first: the new test failed against the pre-fix code before the change.

### 🚨 1. E1 held-anchor drift on trims — fixed (row-exact)

`_heldAnchorShiftedByCut` (`lib/src/cli/fa_tui_viewport.dart:163`) no longer indexes the PRE-trim wrap cache at the shifted line (`starts[heldAnchorLine - cut]`). A same-width trim only removes head rows from the unchanged wrapped layout, so the fix shifts the **raw offset** by the rows the dropped head consumed:

```dart
final droppedRows = starts[cut.clamp(0, starts.length - 1)];
final newBottom = (bottom - droppedRows).clamp(0, bottom);
return (shifted, (scrollOffset - droppedRows).clamp(0, newBottom));
```

Two notes against the prescribed `starts[heldAnchorLine] - starts[cut]` formula:

- That formula alone still snaps a mid-line window up to the anchor line's start row (up to the line's wrap height) — the new regression test caught that intermediate version drifting 1 row.
- The fence-repair synthetic (`cut` is raw-cut − 1 there) can still drift the row by one dropped line's height in that rare shape (noted in code).

**RED first**: `test/cli/fa_tui_follow_mode_test.dart` now has a trim-while-held test with **variable-height lines** (200-char lines every 7th entry) that crosses the 2400-line cap **after** the hold (`cut > 0` exercised — the old E1 test's trim fired before the hold and passed vacuously). It failed on the old math (window drifted several rows) and pins byte-identical rendered rows now.

### 🚨 2. `⌄ N new` counter inflation on history-page loads — fixed (content-aware tail-growth check + the flush it was hiding)

Two defects fixed in `packages/fa_ui/lib/src/chat/fa_chat_screen.dart`:

1. **Counting** (the `fa_chat_screen.dart:998` finding): the arrival check is now **content-aware**. Ids are index-based (`msg-$index`), so a "Load earlier" prepend shifts every row's content while **reusing every id** — the id-based `commonPrefix` stayed `== oldLen` and `newLen - commonPrefix` billed the loaded page as arrivals. The count now scans a content-aware prefix (`countedPrefix`, via the existing `_messageChanged`); arrivals exist iff `countedPrefix == oldLen && newLen > oldLen`, count = `newLen - oldLen` — exactly the prescribed shape, hardened against the id-reuse hole. The render diff keeps the id-based prefix (in-place edits must `updateMessage`, not remove+insert).
2. **The flush behind the repro**: while testing the prepend scenario the pill vanished entirely. Traced: the big-diff `setMessages` re-anchor glides the position for several frames and settles **inside the arm band**; the non-drag relatch then flushed counted arrivals as a fake "user landed back". The non-drag relatch is now gated on a **user gesture in flight** (`_userGestureInFlight`: set by drag updates, kept through `ScrollEnd(dragDetails != null)`, invalidated by content syncs) — content-driven settles can neither flush the count nor hold.

**RED first**: two widget tests — hold → prepend 25 → pill stays at its previous count, and a zero-arrivals prepend never shows the pill. Both failed on the old code (pill showed «25/28 new», or vanished).

### 🚨 3. Wheel/trackpad disengage — implemented (raw PointerScrollEvent classification)

The transcript is now wrapped in a raw `Listener(onPointerSignal: ...)` (`fa_chat_screen.dart:1428`) that marks `PointerScrollEvent` ticks (`_wheelGesturePending`); the next depth-0 scroll update they produce classifies through the **same** `FollowMode.userScrolled` machine as a drag — wheel-up beyond the arm band holds and counts arrivals, wheel-down into the band re-arms live (the reversed-list sign translation is Flutter's own `axisDirectionIsReversed` handling).

E6 stays true, in both directions:

- Programmatic moves can never hold — only the pending-flag path enters the classify branch, and it is consumed by the first classified update.
- Programmatic moves can no longer relatch either (traced while fixing the counter thread): the non-drag relatch is gated on `_userGestureInFlight` (drag/coast only, invalidated by content syncs). Before this gate, a big-diff `setMessages` re-anchor settled at ~60px ≤ arm 80 and the classifier flushed the held count as a fake "user landed back".

**RED first**: two widget tests drive `tester.sendEventToBinding(PointerScrollEvent(...))` — wheel-up during a run arms the pill (failed on the old code: `dragDetails == null` never classified, pill never armed) and wheel-down back to the near-bottom re-arms live.

### 💡 Suggestions — applied

- **One width measure** (`lib/src/cli/fa_tui_rows.dart:213`): `progressWidth = tuiTextWidth('$progressText$counterText')` — the emitted styled run is measured as one string.
- **One owner for the re-engage**: the "Load newer" banner tap is the `_jumpToLive` tear-off (relatch + E4 deep-page-then-jump ordering included; unawaited at the call site). The hand-rolled copy is gone.
- **`heldPreservingUnseen()`** is now library-private `_heldPreservingUnseen()` (only caller: `userScrolled()`); the counting-unit doc on `appended()` states the unit is surface-defined (TUI counts `OutputMsg` events, the app counts message rows) so `● N new` and `⌄ N new` are never "unified" by accident (`lib/src/viewport/follow_mode.dart:96`).

### Verification

- `dart test test/viewport/follow_mode_test.dart test/cli/fa_tui_follow_mode_test.dart` — **38/38** (incl. the new variable-height trim test).
- `cd packages/fa_ui && flutter test` — **581/581** (pill suite 11/11 incl. the two prepend and two wheel regressions; `#1159` banner suite green).
- PTY IT (`test/integration/fa_tui_follow_pty_test.dart --tags integration`) and the full core suite re-run on this head — results in the top-level rework summary.
"}

# GOAL — flutter_agent_harness

## Objective

Build the **ideal cross-platform AI agent harness in Dart**, ported from the
architecture of **pi-mono** (`packages/ai` + `packages/agent`), publishable on
pub.dev and runnable everywhere Dart runs: **VM, Flutter desktop, iOS/Android,
and web**. The core package must stay **pure Dart** — no `dart:io`, no Flutter
imports in `lib/` (platform specifics live behind abstractions).

This repo is the successor to the adk_dart-based assistant stack in the
`yoclip` project; once mature it will power the yoclip Studio AI assistant.

## Reference codebases (read these first)

### Primary architecture reference — pi-mono

### 🚨 1. E1 held-anchor drift on trims — fixed (row-exact)

`_heldAnchorShiftedByCut` (`lib/src/cli/fa_tui_viewport.dart:163`) no longer indexes the PRE-trim wrap cache at the shifted line (`starts[heldAnchorLine - cut]`). A same-width trim only removes head rows from the unchanged wrapped layout, so the fix shifts the **raw offset** by the rows the dropped head consumed:

```dart
final droppedRows = starts[cut.clamp(0, starts.length - 1)];
final newBottom = (bottom - droppedRows).clamp(0, bottom);
return (shifted, (scrollOffset - droppedRows).clamp(0, newBottom));
```

Two notes against the prescribed `starts[heldAnchorLine] - starts[cut]` formula:

- That formula alone still snaps a mid-line window up to the anchor line's start row (up to the line's wrap height) — the new regression test caught that intermediate version drifting 1 row.
- The fence-repair synthetic (`cut` is raw-cut − 1 there) can still drift the row by one dropped line's height in that rare shape (noted in code).

**RED first**: `test/cli/fa_tui_follow_mode_test.dart` now has a trim-while-held test with **variable-height lines** (200-char lines every 7th entry) that crosses the 2400-line cap **after** the hold (`cut > 0` exercised — the old E1 test's trim fired before the hold and passed vacuously). It failed on the old math (window drifted several rows) and pins byte-identical rendered rows now.

### 🚨 2. `⌄ N new` counter inflation on history-page loads — fixed (content-aware tail-growth check + the flush it was hiding)

Two defects fixed in `packages/fa_ui/lib/src/chat/fa_chat_screen.dart`:

1. **Counting** (the `fa_chat_screen.dart:998` finding): the arrival check is now **content-aware**. Ids are index-based (`msg-$index`), so a "Load earlier" prepend shifts every row's content while **reusing every id** — the id-based `commonPrefix` stayed `== oldLen` and `newLen - commonPrefix` billed the loaded page as arrivals. The count now scans a content-aware prefix (`countedPrefix`, via the existing `_messageChanged`); arrivals exist iff `countedPrefix == oldLen && newLen > oldLen`, count = `newLen - oldLen` — exactly the prescribed shape, hardened against the id-reuse hole. The render diff keeps the id-based prefix (in-place edits must `updateMessage`, not remove+insert).
2. **The flush behind the repro**: while testing the prepend scenario the pill vanished entirely. Traced: the big-diff `setMessages` re-anchor glides the position for several frames and settles **inside the arm band**; the non-drag relatch then flushed counted arrivals as a fake "user landed back". The non-drag relatch is now gated on a **user gesture in flight** (`_userGestureInFlight`: set by drag updates, kept through `ScrollEnd(dragDetails != null)`, invalidated by content syncs) — content-driven settles can neither flush the count nor hold.

**RED first**: two widget tests — hold → prepend 25 → pill stays at its previous count, and a zero-arrivals prepend never shows the pill. Both failed on the old code (pill showed «25/28 new», or vanished).

### 🚨 3. Wheel/trackpad disengage — implemented (raw PointerScrollEvent classification)

The transcript is now wrapped in a raw `Listener(onPointerSignal: ...)` (`fa_chat_screen.dart:1428`) that marks `PointerScrollEvent` ticks (`_wheelGesturePending`); the next depth-0 scroll update they produce classifies through the **same** `FollowMode.userScrolled` machine as a drag — wheel-up beyond the arm band holds and counts arrivals, wheel-down into the band re-arms live (the reversed-list sign translation is Flutter's own `axisDirectionIsReversed` handling).

- Programmatic moves can never hold — only the pending-flag path enters the classify branch, and it is consumed by the first classified update.
- Programmatic moves can no longer relatch either (traced while fixing the counter thread): the non-drag relatch is gated on `_userGestureInFlight` (drag/coast only, invalidated by content syncs). Before this gate, a big-diff `setMessages` re-anchor settled at ~60px ≤ arm 80 and the classifier flushed the held count as a fake "user landed back".

**RED first**: two widget tests drive `tester.sendEventToBinding(PointerScrollEvent(...))` — wheel-up during a run arms the pill (failed on the old code: `dragDetails == null` never classified, pill never armed) and wheel-down back to the near-bottom re-arms live.

- **One width measure** (`lib/src/cli/fa_tui_rows.dart:213`): `progressWidth = tuiTextWidth('$progressText$counterText')` — the emitted styled run is measured as one string.

# GOAL — flutter_agent_harness

## Objective

Build the **ideal cross-platform AI agent harness in Dart**, ported from the
architecture of **pi-mono** (`packages/ai` + `packages/agent`), publishable on
pub.dev and runnable everywhere Dart runs: **VM, Flutter desktop, iOS/Android,
and web**. The core package must stay **pure Dart** — no `dart:io`, no Flutter
imports in `lib/` (platform specifics live behind abstractions).

This repo is the successor to the adk_dart-based assistant stack in the
`yoclip` project; once mature it will power the yoclip Studio AI assistant.

A same-width trim only removes head rows from the unchanged wrapped layout, so the fix shifts the **raw offset** by the rows the dropped head consumed:

```dart
final droppedRows = starts[cut.clamp(0, starts.length - 1)];
final newBottom = (bottom - droppedRows).clamp(0, bottom);
return (shifted, (scrollOffset - droppedRows).clamp(0, newBottom));
```

Two notes against the prescribed `starts[heldAnchorLine] - starts[cut]` formula:

- That formula alone still snaps a mid-line window up to the anchor line's start row (up to the line's wrap height) — the new regression test caught that intermediate version drifting 1 row.
- The fence-repair synthetic (`cut` is raw-cut − 1 there) can still drift the row by one dropped line's height in that rare shape (noted in code).

**RED first**: `test/cli/fa_tui_follow_mode_test.dart` now has a trim-while-held test with **variable-height lines** (200-char lines every 7th entry) that crosses the 2400-line cap **after** the hold (`cut > 0` exercised — the old E1 test's trim fired before the hold and passed vacuously). It failed on the old math (window drifted several rows) and pins byte-identical rendered rows now.

### 🚨 2. `⌄ N new` counter inflation on history-page loads — fixed (content-aware tail-growth check + the flush it was hiding)

Two defects fixed in `packages/fa_ui/lib/src/chat/fa_chat_screen.dart`:

1. **Counting** (the `fa_chat_screen.dart:998` finding): the arrival check is now **content-aware**. Ids are index-based (`msg-$index`), so a "Load earlier" prepend shifts every row's content while **reusing every id** — the id-based `commonPrefix` stayed `== oldLen` and `newLen - commonPrefix` billed the loaded page as arrivals. The count now scans a content-aware prefix (`countedPrefix`, via the existing `_messageChanged`); arrivals exist iff `countedPrefix == oldLen && newLen > oldLen`, count = `newLen - oldLen` — exactly the prescribed shape, hardened against the id-reuse hole. The render diff keeps the id-based prefix (in-place edits must `updateMessage`, not remove+insert).
2. **The flush behind the repro**: while testing the prepend scenario the pill vanished entirely. Traced: the big-diff `setMessages` re-anchor glides the position for several frames and settles **inside the arm band**; the non-drag relatch then flushed counted arrivals as a fake "user landed back". The non-drag relatch is now gated on a **user gesture in flight** (`_userGestureInFlight`: set by drag updates, kept through `ScrollEnd(dragDetails != null)`, invalidated by content syncs) — content-driven settles can neither flush the count nor hold.

**RED first**: two widget tests — hold → prepend 25 → pill stays at its previous count, and a zero-arrivals prepend never shows the pill. Both failed on the old code (pill showed «25/28 new», or vanished).

### 🚨 3. Wheel/trackpad disengage — implemented (raw PointerScrollEvent classification)

The transcript is now wrapped in a raw `Listener(onPointerSignal: ...)` (`fa_chat_screen.dart:1428`) that marks `PointerScrollEvent` ticks (`_wheelGesturePending`); the next depth-0 scroll update they produce classifies through the **same** `FollowMode.userScrolled` machine as a drag — wheel-up beyond the arm band holds and counts arrivals, wheel-down into the band re-arms live (the reversed-list sign translation is Flutter's own `axisDirectionIsReversed` handling).

E6 stays true, in both directions:

- Programmatic moves can never hold — only the pending-flag path enters the classify branch, and it is consumed by the first classified update.
- Programmatic moves can no longer relatch either (traced while fixing the counter thread): the non-drag relatch is gated on `_userGestureInFlight` (drag/coast only, invalidated by content syncs). Before this gate, a big-diff `setMessages` re-anchor settled at ~60px ≤ arm 80 and the classifier flushed the held count as a fake "user landed back".

**RED first**: two widget tests drive `tester.sendEventToBinding(PointerScrollEvent(...))` — wheel-up during a run arms the pill (failed on the old code: `dragDetails == null` never classified, pill never armed) and wheel-down back to the near-bottom re-arms live.

### 💡 Suggestions — applied

- **One width measure** (`lib/src/cli/fa_tui_rows.dart:213`): `progressWidth = tuiTextWidth('$progressText$counterText')` — the emitted styled run is measured as one string.
- **One owner for the re-engage**: the "Load newer" banner tap is the `_jumpToLive` tear-off (relatch + E4 deep-page-then-jump ordering included; unawaited at the call site). The hand-rolled copy is gone.
- **`heldPreservingUnseen()`** is now library-private `_heldPreservingUnseen()` (only caller: `userScrolled()`); the counting-unit doc on `appended()` states the unit is surface-defined (TUI counts `OutputMsg` events, the app counts message rows) so `● N new` and `⌄ N new` are never "unified" by accident (`lib/src/viewport/follow_mode.dart:96`).

- `dart test test/viewport/follow_mode_test.dart test/cli/fa_tui_follow_mode_test.dart` — **38/38** (incl. the new variable-height trim test).
- `cd packages/fa_ui && flutter test` — **581/581** (pill suite 11/11 incl. the two prepend and two wheel regressions; `#1159` banner suite green).

# GOAL — flutter_agent_harness

## Objective

Build the **ideal cross-platform AI agent harness in Dart**, ported from the
architecture of **pi-mono** (`packages/ai` + `packages/agent`), publishable on
pub.dev and runnable everywhere Dart runs: **VM, Flutter desktop, iOS/Android,
and web**. The core package must stay **pure Dart** — no `dart:io`, no Flutter
imports in `lib/` (platform specifics live behind abstractions).

This repo is the successor to the adk_dart-based assistant stack in the
`yoclip` project; once mature it will power the yoclip Studio AI assistant.

## Reference codebases (read these first)

### Primary architecture reference — pi-mono

`/Users/Uladzimir_Klyshevich/git/references/pi/`

The fixes landed in the `19:13–19:48` commit round on `ai/gh-1439` (head now past `edb160e2`), plus a cleanup commit dropping the scratch probe the WIP auto-save had left behind. Every fix was RED-first: the new test failed against the pre-fix code before the change.

### 🚨 1. E1 held-anchor drift on trims — fixed (row-exact)

`_heldAnchorShiftedByCut` (`lib/src/cli/fa_tui_viewport.dart:163`) no longer indexes the PRE-trim wrap cache at the shifted line (`starts[heldAnchorLine - cut]`). A same-width trim only removes head rows from the unchanged wrapped layout, so the fix shifts the **raw offset** by the rows the dropped head consumed:

```dart
final droppedRows = starts[cut.clamp(0, starts.length - 1)];
final newBottom = (bottom - droppedRows).clamp(0, bottom);
return (shifted, (scrollOffset - droppedRows).clamp(0, newBottom));
```

Two notes against the prescribed `starts[heldAnchorLine] - starts[cut]` formula:

- That formula alone still snaps a mid-line window up to the anchor line's start row (up to the line's wrap height) — the new regression test caught that intermediate version drifting 1 row.
- The fence-repair synthetic (`cut` is raw-cut − 1 there) can still drift the row by one dropped line's height in that rare shape (noted in code).

**RED first**: `test/cli/fa_tui_follow_mode_test.dart` now has a trim-while-held test with **variable-height lines** (200-char lines every 7th entry) that crosses the 2400-line cap **after** the hold (`cut > 0` exercised — the old E1 test's trim fired before the hold and passed vacuously). It failed on the old math (window drifted several rows) and pins byte-identical rendered rows now.

### 🚨 2. `⌄ N new` counter inflation on history-page loads — fixed (content-aware tail-growth check + the flush it was hiding)

Two defects fixed in `packages/fa_ui/lib/src/chat/fa_chat_screen.dart`:

1. **Counting** (the `fa_chat_screen.dart:998` finding): the arrival check is now **content-aware**. Ids are index-based (`msg-$index`), so a "Load earlier" prepend shifts every row's content while **reusing every id** — the id-based `commonPrefix` stayed `== oldLen` and `newLen - commonPrefix` billed the loaded page as arrivals. The count now scans a content-aware prefix (`countedPrefix`, via the existing `_messageChanged`); arrivals exist iff `countedPrefix == oldLen && newLen > oldLen`, count = `newLen - oldLen` — exactly the prescribed shape, hardened against the id-reuse hole. The render diff keeps the id-based prefix (in-place edits must `updateMessage`, not remove+insert).
2. **The flush behind the repro**: while testing the prepend scenario the pill vanished entirely. Traced: the big-diff `setMessages` re-anchor glides the position for several frames and settles **inside the arm band**; the non-drag relatch then flushed counted arrivals as a fake "user landed back". The non-drag relatch is now gated on a **user gesture in flight** (`_userGestureInFlight`: set by drag updates, kept through `ScrollEnd(dragDetails != null)`, invalidated by content syncs) — content-driven settles can neither flush the count nor hold.

**RED first**: two widget tests — hold → prepend 25 → pill stays at its previous count, and a zero-arrivals prepend never shows the pill. Both failed on the old code (pill showed «25/28 new», or vanished).

### 🚨 3. Wheel/trackpad disengage — implemented (raw PointerScrollEvent classification)

The transcript is now wrapped in a raw `Listener(onPointerSignal: ...)` (`fa_chat_screen.dart:1428`) that marks `PointerScrollEvent` ticks (`_wheelGesturePending`); the next depth-0 scroll update they produce classifies through the **same** `FollowMode.userScrolled` machine as a drag — wheel-up beyond the arm band holds and counts arrivals, wheel-down into the band re-arms live (the reversed-list sign translation is Flutter's own `axisDirectionIsReversed` handling).

E6 stays true, in both directions:

- Programmatic moves can never hold — only the pending-flag path enters the classify branch, and it is consumed by the first classified update.
- Programmatic moves can no longer relatch either (traced while fixing the counter thread): the non-drag relatch is gated on `_userGestureInFlight` (drag/coast only, invalidated by content syncs). Before this gate, a big-diff `setMessages` re-anchor settled at ~60px ≤ arm 80 and the classifier flushed the held count as a fake "user landed back".

**RED first**: two widget tests drive `tester.sendEventToBinding(PointerScrollEvent(...))` — wheel-up during a run arms the pill (failed on the old code: `dragDetails == null` never classified, pill never armed) and wheel-down back to the near-bottom re-arms live.

### 💡 Suggestions — applied

- **One width measure** (`lib/src/cli/fa_tui_rows.dart:213`): `progressWidth = tuiTextWidth('$progressText$counterText')` — the emitted styled run is measured as one string.
- **One owner for the re-engage**: the "Load newer" banner tap is the `_jumpToLive` tear-off (relatch + E4 deep-page-then-jump ordering included; unawaited at the call site). The hand-rolled copy is gone.
- **`heldPreservingUnseen()`** is now library-private `_heldPreservingUnseen()` (only caller: `userScrolled()`); the counting-unit doc on `appended()` states the unit is surface-defined (TUI counts `OutputMsg` events, the app counts message rows) so `● N new` and `⌄ N new` are never "unified" by accident (`lib/src/viewport/follow_mode.dart:96`).

# GOAL — flutter_agent_harness

## Objective

Build the **ideal cross-platform AI agent harness in Dart**, ported from the
architecture of **pi-mono** (`packages/ai` + `packages/agent`), publishable on
pub.dev and runnable everywhere Dart runs: **VM, Flutter desktop, iOS/Android,
and web**. The core package must stay **pure Dart** — no `dart:io`, no Flutter
imports in `lib/` (platform specifics live behind abstractions).

This repo is the successor to the adk_dart-based assistant stack in the
`yoclip` project; once mature it will power the yoclip Studio AI assistant.

## Reference codebases (read these first)

### Primary architecture reference — pi-mono

`/Users/Uladzimir_Klyshevich/git/references/pi/`

- `packages/ai/` (~8.7k LOC TS) — provider adapters behind one contract:
  `stream(model, context, options) → AssistantMessageEventStream`.

    canonical adapter; also covers OpenRouter (`baseUrl` swap, first-class).

    delta event carries the **live partial message** (partial-first design).
  - `packages/ai/src/utils/overflow.ts` — provider-specific context-overflow
    detection via error-message regexes.
  - **Invariant to preserve: providers never throw.** All failures —
    network, 429, abort, malformed SSE — arrive as an `error` event with
    `stopReason: error|aborted`. The agent loop never sees an exception from
    a provider.
- `packages/agent/` (~8.1k LOC TS):
  - `packages/agent/src/agent-loop.ts` (748 LOC) — the low-level async loop;
    port its shape, not its incidental JS-isms.

The fixes landed in the `19:13–19:48` commit round on `ai/gh-1439` (head now past `edb160e2`), plus a cleanup commit dropping the scratch probe the WIP auto-save had left behind. Every fix was RED-first: the new test failed against the pre-fix code before the change.

### 🚨 1. E1 held-anchor drift on trims — fixed (row-exact)

`_heldAnchorShiftedByCut` (`lib/src/cli/fa_tui_viewport.dart:163`) no longer indexes the PRE-trim wrap cache at the shifted line (`starts[heldAnchorLine - cut]`). A same-width trim only removes head rows from the unchanged wrapped layout, so the fix shifts the **raw offset** by the rows the dropped head consumed:

```dart
final droppedRows = starts[cut.clamp(0, starts.length - 1)];
final newBottom = (bottom - droppedRows).clamp(0, bottom);
return (shifted, (scrollOffset - droppedRows).clamp(0, newBottom));
```

Two notes against the prescribed `starts[heldAnchorLine] - starts[cut]` formula:

- That formula alone still snaps a mid-line window up to the anchor line's start row (up to the line's wrap height) — the new regression test caught that intermediate version drifting 1 row.
- The fence-repair synthetic (`cut` is raw-cut − 1 there) can still drift the row by one dropped line's height in that rare shape (noted in code).

**RED first**: `test/cli/fa_tui_follow_mode_test.dart` now has a trim-while-held test with **variable-height lines** (200-char lines every 7th entry) that crosses the 2400-line cap **after** the hold (`cut > 0` exercised — the old E1 test's trim fired before the hold and passed vacuously). It failed on the old math (window drifted several rows) and pins byte-identical rendered rows now.

### 🚨 2. `⌄ N new` counter inflation on history-page loads — fixed (content-aware tail-growth check + the flush it was hiding)

Two defects fixed in `packages/fa_ui/lib/src/chat/fa_chat_screen.dart`:

1. **Counting** (the `fa_chat_screen.dart:998` finding): the arrival check is now **content-aware**. Ids are index-based (`msg-$index`), so a "Load earlier" prepend shifts every row's content while **reusing every id** — the id-based `commonPrefix` stayed `== oldLen` and `newLen - commonPrefix` billed the loaded page as arrivals. The count now scans a content-aware prefix (`countedPrefix`, via the existing `_messageChanged`); arrivals exist iff `countedPrefix == oldLen && newLen > oldLen`, count = `newLen - oldLen` — exactly the prescribed shape, hardened against the id-reuse hole. The render diff keeps the id-based prefix (in-place edits must `updateMessage`, not remove+insert).
2. **The flush behind the repro**: while testing the prepend scenario the pill vanished entirely. Traced: the big-diff `setMessages` re-anchor glides the position for several frames and settles **inside the arm band**; the non-drag relatch then flushed counted arrivals as a fake "user landed back". The non-drag relatch is now gated on a **user gesture in flight** (`_userGestureInFlight`: set by drag updates, kept through `ScrollEnd(dragDetails != null)`, invalidated by content syncs) — content-driven settles can neither flush the count nor hold.

**RED first**: two widget tests — hold → prepend 25 → pill stays at its previous count, and a zero-arrivals prepend never shows the pill. Both failed on the old code (pill showed «25/28 new», or vanished).

### 🚨 3. Wheel/trackpad disengage — implemented (raw PointerScrollEvent classification)

The transcript is now wrapped in a raw `Listener(onPointerSignal: ...)` (`fa_chat_screen.dart:1428`) that marks `PointerScrollEvent` ticks (`_wheelGesturePending`); the next depth-0 scroll update they produce classifies through the **same** `FollowMode.userScrolled` machine as a drag — wheel-up beyond the arm band holds and counts arrivals, wheel-down into the band re-arms live (the reversed-list sign translation is Flutter's own `axisDirectionIsReversed` handling).

E6 stays true, in both directions:

- Programmatic moves can never hold — only the pending-flag path enters the classify branch, and it is consumed by the first classified update.
- Programmatic moves can no longer relatch either (traced while fixing the counter thread): the non-drag relatch is gated on `_userGestureInFlight` (drag/coast only, invalidated by content syncs). Before this gate, a big-diff `setMessages` re-anchor settled at ~60px ≤ arm 80 and the classifier flushed the held count as a fake "user landed back".

**RED first**: two widget tests drive `tester.sendEventToBinding(PointerScrollEvent(...))` — wheel-up during a run arms the pill (failed on the old code: `dragDetails == null` never classified, pill never armed) and wheel-down back to the near-bottom re-arms live.

### 💡 Suggestions — applied

- **One width measure** (`lib/src/cli/fa_tui_rows.dart:213`): `progressWidth = tuiTextWidth('$progressText$counterText')` — the emitted styled run is measured as one string.

# GOAL — flutter_agent_harness

## Objective

Build the **ideal cross-platform AI agent harness in Dart**, ported from the
architecture of **pi-mono** (`packages/ai` + `packages/agent`), publishable on
pub.dev and runnable everywhere Dart runs: **VM, Flutter desktop, iOS/Android,
and web**. The core package must stay **pure Dart** — no `dart:io`, no Flutter
imports in `lib/` (platform specifics live behind abstractions).

This repo is the successor to the adk_dart-based assistant stack in the
`yoclip` project; once mature it will power the yoclip Studio AI assistant.

## Reference codebases (read these first)

### Primary architecture reference — pi-mono

`/Users/Uladzimir_Klyshevich/git/references/pi/`

- `packages/ai/` (~8.7k LOC TS) — provider adapters behind one contract:
  `stream(model, context, options) → AssistantMessageEventStream`.

    canonical adapter; also covers OpenRouter (`baseUrl` swap, first-class).

    hand-rolled SSE decoder at lines 260–409; port this to Dart.
  - `packages/ai/src/stream.ts` — event contract:
    `start → text/thinking/toolcall_{start,delta,end} → done|error`, every
    delta event carries the **live partial message** (partial-first design).
  - `packages/ai/src/utils/overflow.ts` — provider-specific context-overflow
    detection via error-message regexes.
  - **Invariant to preserve: providers never throw.** All failures —
    network, 429, abort, malformed SSE — arrive as an `error` event with
    `stopReason: error|aborted`. The agent loop never sees an exception from
    a provider.
- `packages/agent/` (~8.1k LOC TS):

The fixes landed in the `19:13–19:48` commit round on `ai/gh-1439` (head now past `edb160e2`), plus a cleanup commit dropping the scratch probe the WIP auto-save had left behind. Every fix was RED-first: the new test failed against the pre-fix code before the change.

### 🚨 1. E1 held-anchor drift on trims — fixed (row-exact)

`_heldAnchorShiftedByCut` (`lib/src/cli/fa_tui_viewport.dart:163`) no longer indexes the PRE-trim wrap cache at the shifted line (`starts[heldAnchorLine - cut]`). A same-width trim only removes head rows from the unchanged wrapped layout, so the fix shifts the **raw offset** by the rows the dropped head consumed:

```dart
final droppedRows = starts[cut.clamp(0, starts.length - 1)];
final newBottom = (bottom - droppedRows).clamp(0, bottom);
return (shifted, (scrollOffset - droppedRows).clamp(0, newBottom));
```

Two notes against the prescribed `starts[heldAnchorLine] - starts[cut]` formula:

- That formula alone still snaps a mid-line window up to the anchor line's start row (up to the line's wrap height) — the new regression test caught that intermediate version drifting 1 row.
- The fence-repair synthetic (`cut` is raw-cut − 1 there) can still drift the row by one dropped line's height in that rare shape (noted in code).

**RED first**: `test/cli/fa_tui_follow_mode_test.dart` now has a trim-while-held test with **variable-height lines** (200-char lines every 7th entry) that crosses the 2400-line cap **after** the hold (`cut > 0` exercised — the old E1 test's trim fired before the hold and passed vacuously). It failed on the old math (window drifted several rows) and pins byte-identical rendered rows now.

### 🚨 2. `⌄ N new` counter inflation on history-page loads — fixed (content-aware tail-growth check + the flush it was hiding)

Two defects fixed in `packages/fa_ui/lib/src/chat/fa_chat_screen.dart`:

1. **Counting** (the `fa_chat_screen.dart:998` finding): the arrival check is now **content-aware**. Ids are index-based (`msg-$index`), so a "Load earlier" prepend shifts every row's content while **reusing every id** — the id-based `commonPrefix` stayed `== oldLen` and `newLen - commonPrefix` billed the loaded page as arrivals. The count now scans a content-aware prefix (`countedPrefix`, via the existing `_messageChanged`); arrivals exist iff `countedPrefix == oldLen && newLen > oldLen`, count = `newLen - oldLen` — exactly the prescribed shape, hardened against the id-reuse hole. The render diff keeps the id-based prefix (in-place edits must `updateMessage`, not remove+insert).
2. **The flush behind the repro**: while testing the prepend scenario the pill vanished entirely. Traced: the big-diff `setMessages` re-anchor glides the position for several frames and settles **inside the arm band**; the non-drag relatch then flushed counted arrivals as a fake "user landed back". The non-drag relatch is now gated on a **user gesture in flight** (`_userGestureInFlight`: set by drag updates, kept through `ScrollEnd(dragDetails != null)`, invalidated by content syncs) — content-driven settles can neither flush the count nor hold.

**RED first**: two widget tests — hold → prepend 25 → pill stays at its previous count, and a zero-arrivals prepend never shows the pill. Both failed on the old code (pill showed «25/28 new», or vanished).

### 🚨 3. Wheel/trackpad disengage — implemented (raw PointerScrollEvent classification)

The transcript is now wrapped in a raw `Listener(onPointerSignal: ...)` (`fa_chat_screen.dart:1428`) that marks `PointerScrollEvent` ticks (`_wheelGesturePending`); the next depth-0 scroll update they produce classifies through the **same** `FollowMode.userScrolled` machine as a drag — wheel-up beyond the arm band holds and counts arrivals, wheel-down into the band re-arms live (the reversed-list sign translation is Flutter's own `axisDirectionIsReversed` handling).

E6 stays true, in both directions:

- Programmatic moves can never hold — only the pending-flag path enters the classify branch, and it is consumed by the first classified update.
- Programmatic moves can no longer relatch either (traced while fixing the counter thread): the non-drag relatch is gated on `_userGestureInFlight` (drag/coast only, invalidated by content syncs). Before this gate, a big-diff `setMessages` re-anchor settled at ~60px ≤ arm 80 and the classifier flushed the held count as a fake "user landed back".

**RED first**: two widget tests drive `tester.sendEventToBinding(PointerScrollEvent(...))` — wheel-up during a run arms the pill (failed on the old code: `dragDetails == null` never classified, pill never armed) and wheel-down back to the near-bottom re-arms live.

### 💡 Suggestions — applied

- **One width measure** (`lib/src/cli/fa_tui_rows.dart:213`): `progressWidth = tuiTextWidth('$progressText$counterText')` — the emitted styled run is measured as one string.
- **One owner for the re-engage**: the "Load newer" banner tap is the `_jumpToLive` tear-off (relatch + E4 deep-page-then-jump ordering included; unawaited at the call site). The hand-rolled copy is gone.
- **`heldPreservingUnseen()`** is now library-private `_heldPreservingUnseen()` (only caller: `userScrolled()`); the counting-unit doc on `appended()` states the unit is surface-defined (TUI counts `OutputMsg` events, the app counts message rows) so `● N new` and `⌄ N new` are never "unified" by accident (`lib/src/viewport/follow_mode.dart:96`).

- `dart test test/viewport/follow_mode_test.dart test/cli/fa_tui_follow_mode_test.dart` — **38/38** (incl. the new variable-height trim test).
- `cd packages/fa_ui && flutter test` — **581/581** (pill suite 11/11 incl. the two prepend and two wheel regressions; `#1159` banner suite green).
- PTY IT (`test/integration/fa_tui_follow_pty_test.dart --tags integration`) and the full core suite re-run on this head — results in the top-level rework summary.

# GOAL — flutter_agent_harness

## Objective

Build the **ideal cross-platform AI agent harness in Dart**, ported from the
architecture of **pi-mono** (`packages/ai` + `packages/agent`), publishable on
pub.dev and runnable everywhere Dart runs: **VM, Flutter desktop, iOS/Android,
and web**. The core package must stay **pure Dart** — no `dart:io`, no Flutter
imports in `lib/` (platform specifics live behind abstractions).

This repo is the successor to the adk_dart-based assistant stack in the
`yoclip` project; once mature it will power the yoclip Studio AI assistant.

## Reference codebases (read these first)

### Primary architecture reference — pi-mono

`/Users/Uladzimir_Klyshevich/git/references/pi/`

- `packages/ai/` (~8.7k LOC TS) — provider adapters behind one contract:
  `stream(model, context, options) → AssistantMessageEventStream`.
  Study these files before writing any provider code:
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/openai-completions.ts` (~1205 LOC) — the
    canonical adapter; also covers OpenRouter (`baseUrl` swap, first-class).
  - `packages/ai/src/providers/anthropic.ts` (~1242 LOC) — includes a
    hand-rolled SSE decoder at lines 260–409; port this to Dart.
  - `packages/ai/src/stream.ts` — event contract:
    `start → text/thinking/toolcall_{start,delta,end} → done|error`, every

The fixes landed in the `19:13–19:48` commit round on `ai/gh-1439` (head now past `edb160e2`), plus a cleanup commit dropping the scratch probe the WIP auto-save had left behind. Every fix was RED-first: the new test failed against the pre-fix code before the change.

### 🚨 1. E1 held-anchor drift on trims — fixed (row-exact)

`_heldAnchorShiftedByCut` (`lib/src/cli/fa_tui_viewport.dart:163`) no longer indexes the PRE-trim wrap cache at the shifted line (`starts[heldAnchorLine - cut]`). A same-width trim only removes head rows from the unchanged wrapped layout, so the fix shifts the **raw offset** by the rows the dropped head consumed:

```dart
final droppedRows = starts[cut.clamp(0, starts.length - 1)];
final newBottom = (bottom - droppedRows).clamp(0, bottom);
return (shifted, (scrollOffset - droppedRows).clamp(0, newBottom));
```

Two notes against the prescribed `starts[heldAnchorLine] - starts[cut]` formula:

- That formula alone still snaps a mid-line window up to the anchor line's start row (up to the line's wrap height) — the new regression test caught that intermediate version drifting 1 row.
- The fence-repair synthetic (`cut` is raw-cut − 1 there) can still drift the row by one dropped line's height in that rare shape (noted in code).

**RED first**: `test/cli/fa_tui_follow_mode_test.dart` now has a trim-while-held test with **variable-height lines** (200-char lines every 7th entry) that crosses the 2400-line cap **after** the hold (`cut > 0` exercised — the old E1 test's trim fired before the hold and passed vacuously). It failed on the old math (window drifted several rows) and pins byte-identical rendered rows now.

### 🚨 2. `⌄ N new` counter inflation on history-page loads — fixed (content-aware tail-growth check + the flush it was hiding)

Two defects fixed in `packages/fa_ui/lib/src/chat/fa_chat_screen.dart`:

1. **Counting** (the `fa_chat_screen.dart:998` finding): the arrival check is now **content-aware**. Ids are index-based (`msg-$index`), so a "Load earlier" prepend shifts every row's content while **reusing every id** — the id-based `commonPrefix` stayed `== oldLen` and `newLen - commonPrefix` billed the loaded page as arrivals. The count now scans a content-aware prefix (`countedPrefix`, via the existing `_messageChanged`); arrivals exist iff `countedPrefix == oldLen && newLen > oldLen`, count = `newLen - oldLen` — exactly the prescribed shape, hardened against the id-reuse hole. The render diff keeps the id-based prefix (in-place edits must `updateMessage`, not remove+insert).
2. **The flush behind the repro**: while testing the prepend scenario the pill vanished entirely. Traced: the big-diff `setMessages` re-anchor glides the position for several frames and settles **inside the arm band**; the non-drag relatch then flushed counted arrivals as a fake "user landed back". The non-drag relatch is now gated on a **user gesture in flight** (`_userGestureInFlight`: set by drag updates, kept through `ScrollEnd(dragDetails != null)`, invalidated by content syncs) — content-driven settles can neither flush the count nor hold.

**RED first**: two widget tests — hold → prepend 25 → pill stays at its previous count, and a zero-arrivals prepend never shows the pill. Both failed on the old code (pill showed «25/28 new», or vanished).

### 🚨 3. Wheel/trackpad disengage — implemented (raw PointerScrollEvent classification)

The transcript is now wrapped in a raw `Listener(onPointerSignal: ...)` (`fa_chat_screen.dart:1428`) that marks `PointerScrollEvent` ticks (`_wheelGesturePending`); the next depth-0 scroll update they produce classifies through the **same** `FollowMode.userScrolled` machine as a drag — wheel-up beyond the arm band holds and counts arrivals, wheel-down into the band re-arms live (the reversed-list sign translation is Flutter's own `axisDirectionIsReversed` handling).

E6 stays true, in both directions:

- Programmatic moves can never hold — only the pending-flag path enters the classify branch, and it is consumed by the first classified update.
- Programmatic moves can no longer relatch either (traced while fixing the counter thread): the non-drag relatch is gated on `_userGestureInFlight` (drag/coast only, invalidated by content syncs). Before this gate, a big-diff `setMessages` re-anchor settled at ~60px ≤ arm 80 and the classifier flushed the held count as a fake "user landed back".

**RED first**: two widget tests drive `tester.sendEventToBinding(PointerScrollEvent(...))` — wheel-up during a run arms the pill (failed on the old code: `dragDetails == null` never classified, pill never armed) and wheel-down back to the near-bottom re-arms live.

### 💡 Suggestions — applied

- **One width measure** (`lib/src/cli/fa_tui_rows.dart:213`): `progressWidth = tuiTextWidth('$progressText$counterText')` — the emitted styled run is measured as one string.
- **One owner for the re-engage**: the "Load newer" banner tap is the `_jumpToLive` tear-off (relatch + E4 deep-page-then-jump ordering included; unawaited at the call site). The hand-rolled copy is gone.
- **`heldPreservingUnseen()`** is now library-private `_heldPreservingUnseen()` (only caller: `userScrolled()`); the counting-unit doc on `appended()` states the unit is surface-defined (TUI counts `OutputMsg` events, the app counts message rows) so `● N new` and `⌄ N new` are never "unified" by accident (`lib/src/viewport/follow_mode.dart:96`).

# gh-1439 rework — the three open blockers fixed, tests re-verified on the head

## Issues/Notes

- The previous rework round was interrupted mid-flight (a trail of WIP auto-save commits 19:13–19:48) — its fixes **were** on the branch but the round never closed: a scratch debug probe (`packages/fa_ui/test/scratch_probe_test.dart`) was still committed and no final verification/output was produced. This round finished it: dropped the probe, re-ran every suite on the final head, and answered all four open threads.
- The four open threads: the automated review (thread with the 3 🚨 + 3 💡), its re-review duplicate (same findings byte-identical), and two machine/ops records (the `ai_validating` unstick note and the gh-807 verdict record) — no code content in the latter two; replies posted so they can be resolved.
- Pre-existing, untouched by this PR: 78 analyzer errors in `office_addin/` (a separate sub-package whose deps are not fetched in this checkout); `flutter_app` tests cannot run here (missing dev-local `.env` asset, fails before Dart compiles — as already noted in the PR description).

## Approach

All fixes were RED-first (each new test failed against the pre-fix code), and all three blockers were confirmed fixed on the final head:

1. **E1 held-anchor drift on trims** (`lib/src/cli/fa_tui_viewport.dart:163`) — `_heldAnchorShiftedByCut` no longer reads the PRE-trim wrap cache at the shifted line. A same-width trim only removes head rows from the unchanged wrapped layout, so the window re-anchors by shifting the raw offset by the rows the dropped head consumed (`scrollOffset - starts_old[cut]`, clamped to the new bottom) — a window parked mid-line (a continuation row of a wrapped line) survives exactly. (The prescribed `starts[heldAnchorLine] - starts[cut]` variant was tried first; the new regression test caught it drifting 1 row by snapping mid-line windows to the anchor line's start.) New trim-while-held test with **variable-height lines** (200-char lines every 7th entry) that crosses the 2400-line cap **after** the hold, so `cut > 0` is genuinely exercised — the old E1 test's trim fired before the hold and passed vacuously.
2. **`⌄ N new` counter inflation on history-page prepends** (`packages/fa_ui/lib/src/chat/fa_chat_screen.dart:1043`) — the arrival check is content-aware: ids are index-based (`msg-$index`) and a "Load earlier" prepend shifts every row's content while **reusing every id**, so the id-based `commonPrefix` never collapsed. Arrivals now require a content-aware pure-tail growth (`countedPrefix == oldLen && newLen > oldLen`, count `newLen - oldLen`); prepends and in-place edits never count. Fixed additionally the flush the repro exposed: the big-diff `setMessages` re-anchor glided for several frames and settled inside the arm band, where the non-drag relatch flushed the held count as a fake "user landed back" — the relatch is now gated on a user gesture in flight (set by drag updates, kept through `ScrollEnd(dragDetails != null)`, invalidated by content syncs).
3. **Wheel/trackpad could never disengage on app/web** (`packages/fa_ui/lib/src/chat/fa_chat_screen.dart:1428`) — the transcript is wrapped in a raw `Listener(onPointerSignal:)` that marks `PointerScrollEvent` ticks; the next depth-0 scroll update classifies through the same core `FollowMode.userScrolled` machine as a drag (wheel-up beyond the arm band holds + counts arrivals, wheel-down into the band re-arms live). E6 holds both ways: only the pending-flag path can hold, and the non-drag relatch requires a gesture in flight, so the #379 clamp's own `animateTo` can neither hold nor relatch.
4. **The three 💡 suggestions applied**: one width measure for the combined rule run (`tuiTextWidth('$progressText$counterText')`, `lib/src/cli/fa_tui_rows.dart:213`); the "Load newer" banner tap is the `_jumpToLive` tear-off (one owner for the re-engage, E4 ordering included); `heldPreservingUnseen()` is private `_heldPreservingUnseen()` with the surface-defined counting unit documented on `appended()` (`lib/src/viewport/follow_mode.dart:96`).
5. **Cleanup**: the WIP round's committed scratch probe removed from `packages/fa_ui/test/` (the real regressions live in `fa_chat_follow_pill_test.dart`).

## Files Modified

- `packages/fa_ui/test/scratch_probe_test.dart` — deleted (WIP debug scaffolding; this round's only tree change — the three blocker fixes + suggestion applications were landed by the immediately preceding commit round on this branch).

Files carrying the fixes (verified this round, changed relative to the reviewed head `b9a1e1fa8`):

- `lib/src/cli/fa_tui_viewport.dart` — E1 row-exact re-anchor.
- `packages/fa_ui/lib/src/chat/fa_chat_screen.dart` — content-aware arrival counting, gesture-gated relatch, `PointerScrollEvent` classification, banner tap → `_jumpToLive`.
- `lib/src/cli/fa_tui_rows.dart` — single width measure for the rule run.
- `lib/src/viewport/follow_mode.dart` — private held transition + counting-unit doc.
- `test/cli/fa_tui_follow_mode_test.dart` — variable-height trim-while-held regression.
- `packages/fa_ui/test/fa_chat_follow_pill_test.dart` — prepend-while-held × 2, wheel-up arming, wheel-down re-arming widget tests.

## Test Coverage

- `dart test test/viewport/follow_mode_test.dart test/cli/fa_tui_follow_mode_test.dart` — **38/38** (incl. the new E1 variable-height trim test and the full AC/REG pin set).
- `cd packages/fa_ui && flutter test` — **581/581** (pill suite 11/11 incl. the four re-review regressions; `#1159` banner suite green).
- PTY IT: `dart test test/integration/fa_tui_follow_pty_test.dart --tags integration` — **passed** (scroll-up mid-run holds the fold, arrivals count, End returns live, through the real binary).
- `flutter analyze` (packages/fa_ui) — no issues in the PR files; `dart analyze` — no issues outside the pre-existing `office_addin/` sub-package.
- Full core suite (`dart test --exclude-tags integration`, ~9.8k tests) — re-run on the final head as the regression gate (see the run note below).

REG pins from the ticket re-verified green: `#827` live-fold hint, `#1159` banner, `#379` clamp, `#1348` stream-owns-the-window, `#278` capture-off wheel silence.

# GOAL — flutter_agent_harness

## Objective

Build the **ideal cross-platform AI agent harness in Dart**, ported from the
architecture of **pi-mono** (`packages/ai` + `packages/agent`), publishable on
pub.dev and runnable everywhere Dart runs: **VM, Flutter desktop, iOS/Android,
and web**. The core package must stay **pure Dart** — no `dart:io`, no Flutter
imports in `lib/` (platform specifics live behind abstractions).

This repo is the successor to the adk_dart-based assistant stack in the
`yoclip` project; once mature it will power the yoclip Studio AI assistant.

## Reference codebases (read these first)

### Primary architecture reference — pi-mono

`/Users/Uladzimir_Klyshevich/git/references/pi/`

- `packages/ai/` (~8.7k LOC TS) — provider adapters behind one contract:

    `start → text/thinking/toolcall_{start,delta,end} → done|error`, every
    delta event carries the **live partial message** (partial-first design).
  - `packages/ai/src/utils/overflow.ts` — provider-specific context-overflow
    detection via error-message regexes.
  - **Invariant to preserve: providers never throw.** All failures —
    network, 429, abort, malformed SSE — arrive as an `error` event with
    `stopReason: error|aborted`. The agent loop never sees an exception from
    a provider.
